prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: source-aligned grayscale HEIGHT GUIDE for a tangent-space normal map. The input is an EXACT 8 by 8 checker tile floor albedo. Preserve its square framing, the exact 8x8 layout and every thin joint at x/y multiples of 1/8 including border joints. Both BLACK and CREAM tile faces MUST become the SAME uniform light-midgray height; their color difference is printed pigment and MUST NOT become alternating height. Lower only the narrow grout lines to a dark-midgray shallow groove, with very narrow softly rounded bevels along the exact visible tile edges. Tile faces remain flat, equally tall and calm; remove all stains, print, scratches, brightness gradients, light and shadow. The output is grayscale height, NOT purple normal map: higher=brighter, lower=darker. No new lines, no displaced grid, no thick joints, no crop, no rotation, no frame or text. Preserve exact border continuation.
reference_invariants: Original albedo is untouched. Output is only supplemental guide; final geometric features come from original-source masks.
limitations: The generated guide is not accepted as an exact per-pixel geometry match.
Generated guides can contain interpreted shading; periodic bandpass and tiny guide weight suppress it.
Exact model version is not exposed.
